**Done: `S1747.SurjectiveSplit K` is proved (EXIT=0, no `sorry`, no new axiom).**

## Deliverable

[S1811SurjectiveSplitDedicatedActual.lean](tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1811SurjectiveSplitDedicatedActual.lean) (215 lines)

| decl | line | statement |
|---|---|---|
| `S1811.pi_single_one_mul` | 68 | `Pi.single j 1 * b = Pi.single j (b j)` |
| `S1811.split_prod` | 81 | splitting for a finite product of fields (core) |
| `S1811.surjectiveSplit` | 176 | `S1747.SurjectiveSplit K` — same statement, same quantifiers |

## Verification

```
lake env lean -j1 -R 'D:\lean' -o .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1811SurjectiveSplitDedicatedActual.olean \
  tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1811SurjectiveSplitDedicatedActual.lean
→ EXIT=0 (no errors, no warnings)
```

- lean SHA256 `1C9E00C846AAB023A9B88F5957B4D46B53FB6CEFE58CD636029EF422EF641F91` (9366 B)
- olean SHA256 `13F8A9B5BC94495C6CB9DA7171E0DECBF9C94412FC657E43497C028C10357DCC` (430744 B), identical in `.lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/` and `tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/`; a full rebuild reproduced the same hash.
- axioms: `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]` (surjectiveSplit, split_prod); no `sorryAx`.

## Why it closes (and is simpler than the sketched routes)

Decompose **only** `B` via `Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod`; no decomposition of `A`, no `exists_factor`, no tensor-product test algebras. Let `S := {j | ψ (Pi.single j 1) = 0}` be the set of components killed by `ψ = φ ∘ eB⁻¹`. Then `ker ψ = {b | b vanishes off S}` (both inclusions are one-line `Pi.single` computations), so `C := ∏_{j∈S} B_j` is a product of finite separable fields (hence finite étale) and `b ↦ (ψ b, b|_S)` is `B ≃ₐ[K] A × C` with first projection `φ`. This is exactly the intended `B ≃ A × C`, but the complement is read off the **kernel** rather than from an injection of index sets — which is what made it formalizable.

## Consumer check (compiled, EXIT=0)

[S1811ConsumerProbe.lean](tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1811ConsumerProbe.lean) confirms the statement matches (`example : S1747.SurjectiveSplit K := S1811.surjectiveSplit`) and that it plugs in: `S1786.FiniteEtaleSplit K`, the (G3) field `S1786.MonoInducesIsoOnDirectSummandField K`, and the actual `PreGaloisCategory (CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale K)^op`. **After this file the only remaining gap for (G3) is `S1747.EpiSurjective K`.**

Bookkeeping: [S1811.log](tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1811.log) records command/EXIT/SHA/axioms; scratch probes deleted. I did **not** touch `S1747`/`S1786` or the coordination docs (`coord/STATE.md`, `coord/queue.md`, `AUDIT_LEDGER.md`) — reported to the parent that those updates (incl. the stale `MAINLINE_ABC_F.md` note that `exists_factor` is the gap) are pending on their side.
